Class SessionAccountsLoginBeginRequest

java.lang.Object
com.github.copilot.generated.rpc.SessionAccountsLoginBeginRequest
@CopilotExperimental @Generated("copilot-sdk-codegen") public final class SessionAccountsLoginBeginRequest extends Object
Begin an interactive login flow for a provider kind, optionally reusing a cached base identity or explicitly requesting provider account selection.

Required inputs are constructor arguments. Optional inputs have fluent setters.

Since:
1.0.0
